championBefore.name: Aurelia, the Last Foundry
championBefore.lore: When Valdur's furnaces went cold, Aurelia carried their last living coal inside her own iron heart. She has crossed a century of battlefields rebuilding soldiers that kings had already written off. Her forge asks neither banner nor birthplace, only whether there is still someone inside the armor worth bringing home.

passive.name: Tempered Resolve
passive.desc: Immune to Decrease DEF. This permanent protection affects only Aurelia.

championBefore.name: Ilyra Snowglass
championBefore.lore: Blue threads run between the charcoal rosettes of Ilyra's snow-leopard coat, as though the mountain sky were caught beneath her fur. championBefore.name: Cinder-Mender Vessa
championBefore.lore: Vessa once tended the furnaces beneath the Seventh Pit, where mercy was counted as wasted fuel. When a broken legion crawled home, she stole a coal from the punishment fires and taught it to close wounds instead. Now her lantern burns for anyone still breathing, and the pitmasters follow its light with chains.

championBefore.name: Oruun, the Prism-Seer
championBefore.lore: Oruun's long lynx ear-tufts are threaded with tiny prisms, and his violet-gray fur bears pale geometric bands no scholar can explain. When the sun-prides shattered, he collected a fragment from every broken oath-stone. He studies their light for a future in which none of the prides must stand alone.

championBefore.name: Vorrek, the Walking Siege
championBefore.lore: Vorrek held the eastern siege line until the generals spent his last soldier. Rather than accept a replacement army, he ordered the surviving engineers to build the breach around him. His furnace still burns with the names of those who never came home, and no fortress has yet persuaded him to turn aside.

passive.name: Unbroken Advance
passive.desc: Vorrek is immune to Weaken. This permanent protection affects only him.

championBefore.name: Veyr, the Hollow Gate
championBefore.lore: When the Nameless Quarter slipped into shadow, its watchman held the evacuation gate until the last lantern crossed. Dawn found only his armor, still standing. Veyr no longer remembers the people he saved, but whenever footsteps flee through the dark, he turns his shield toward whatever follows.

championBefore.name: Renn Briarhook
championBefore.lore: Renn once marked trees for the royal timber road until he heard voices beneath the bark. His hook now tears the axle pins from the logging wagons, and the abandoned road grows narrower every spring. He keeps the last survey stake on his belt to remember how easily a straight line becomes a wound.

championBefore.name: Nerez, the Veil Bastion
championBefore.lore: The old city paid its night watch in promises that the dawn would come. When an eclipse swallowed the final sunrise, Nerez kept his post anyway. Travelers now follow the scrape of his shield through streets that maps refuse to remember, knowing the thing behind them will have to answer his challenge first.

championBefore.name: Mavra Dusktrail
championBefore.lore: The smoky markings across Mavra's puma shoulders look like the canyon shadows in which she grew up. She once guided trophy hunters to the high passes, until she discovered what they carried in their covered wagons. Now her arrows guide the prisoners home, and the hunters learn how far a scream travels in the dusk.

championBefore.lore: Lian left the imperial physicians after learning that medicine was reserved for officers. The little dragon in his bowl was once offered a throne; it chose to help him carry water instead.
